column1: # Stage S14 W2: the Enfusion mod is the one product `apps/` still held, so it moves to a top-level
# `mod/` and `apps/` goes; its documentation mirror follows to `documentation/mod/`, at the mod's
# code path under `documentation/` like every other mirror. The addon folder names, GUIDs,
# `.gproj` files and `{GUID}` resource paths stay as they are: Workbench reads them relative to
# each addon, never to the repository root.
# `apps/README.md` and `documentation/apps/README.md` merge into the two mod READMEs and leave in
# the same change. No row names them: a `path` row moves a tracked file and a `text` row rewrites
# an identifier-like token, while the three links to the first are repository-root link
# destinations (`/apps/README.md`), which the same change points at `/mod/README.md`; no live file
# links the second. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# The mod suite and its documentation mirror
